scope: Additive preservation of exact historical source/development/documentation bytes. Active component definitions, build inputs and runtime requirements are unchanged.

license_provenance.interpretation: Original MIT notices, translation attribution and distinct renderer GPL/MIT texts are retained verbatim in their original relative positions. No blanket relicensing or assignment of the archive to a new license.

verification.mode_handling: Original Git modes are recorded. Windows filesystem executable flags are not used as a substitute for Git modes.
